about: The no-hand-written-URL-path rule, read by scripts/platform/lint/no-url-paths.mjs and python/tests/platform/test_gates_hygiene.py so the two cannot drift. A platform module names an operation by SDK name; only the generated table holds path templates. 'pattern' matches a quoted literal that starts with a platform route or a path under the platform mount. The bare mount "/omega/api" is the origin's base path (the derived platform origin is {base_url}/omega/api), not an operation path, so it is allowed. Comment lines may describe a path. Tests and test fixtures are not platform modules.
